Install or update with Homebrew: `brew tap fanzzzd/sidescreen && brew install --cask sidescreen`, or `brew upgrade --cask sidescreen`. Or download the DMG below. It's signed but not notarized: the first time you open the downloaded app, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Sidescreen.app`. Homebrew does that for you.
